photos.desc: A young pet female Derbyan Parakeet (also known as Lord Derby's Parakeet). Its beak is not yet the black colour of the adult female and it has some green plumage on its crown.
A male Lord Derby's Parakeet Psittacula derbiana in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China (not native in this region; an escape from captivity or feral).
An adult male Lord Derby's Parakeet (Psittacula derbiana) at the Louro Parque, Madeira.
Derbyan parakeet ( Psittacula derbiana ) by the side of a house in Bomê County, Tibet.
A female Derbyan Parakeet in captivity in the street near Guo Zi Jian, Beijeng, China.
Derbyan parakeet ( Psittacula_derbiana ). A juvenile playing with a bolt on a cage. Juveniles have dark irises, orange-red upper and lower mandible and a green crown.
Psittacula derbiana, drawing from nature by J. Gould (1804-1881) & H.C. Richter (1821-1902)
